purpose: Frozen arm registry for the OPWS R1 protocol. Every registered arm's selected file scope for a task comes from a pre-existing FROZEN prediction artifact. No new predictions are produced by this mission.
population_note: Artifacts below cover the frozen MAIN_297 manifest population (297 tasks). The final OPWS population is the FUTURE Full-D7 READY binding; per-task arm-level scope lists are read from these frozen artifacts only for tasks in the bound population. Full D7 outcomes were NOT consulted.

arms.scope_source: research/saleor-reserve-300-rmcss/saleor_reserve_300_proxies.json (observed historical changed NON-TEST file set per task)
arms.scope_capability: complete reference non-test patch (all historically changed non-test files)
arms.note: Diagnostic floor/validity control only. NEVER presented as a competitive method. Under correct oracle-patch semantics GOLD must reconstruct the full reference non-test patch.

arms.scope_capability: maximal canonical scope (entire frozen selectable universe)
arms.note: Ceiling/control because its scope is maximal. Not an ordinary competitor.

arms.scope_source: deterministically sampled from the same frozen selectable universe with the same selected-file count as RM-CSS for that task (sampling below)

random_contract.same_selected_file_count: |scope| == RM-CSS scope size for the same task
random_contract.universe: same frozen selectable repository-file universe used by RM-CSS for that task
random_contract.no_gold_exclusion: no file excluded based on gold labels
random_contract.saturation: if universe size < requested scope size, select the complete universe and record saturation

arms.scope_capability: structural adaptation control (BM25 retrieval expanded by one-hop
arms.note: Structural/control arm registered because its frozen prediction artifact is confirmed in the R2 freeze. NEVER labeled as exact published CIA.

arms.scope_capability: file-level localization adaptation (Agentless style) on the frozen MAIN_297 population
budget-bounded iterative agent selected file scope

arms.primary_comparison: RM_CSS vs AGENT on the primary paired eligible population

arm_artifact_resolution.note: Every named arm's frozen prediction artifact exists and is identified unambiguously. No ARM_ARTIFACT_UNRESOLVED is recorded for any core arm.

selection_lists_semantics.normalization: repository-relative forward-slash paths, exactly as stored in each frozen artifact
selection_lists_semantics.dedup: duplicate paths removed before scope-hash (set semantics); duplicates counted in duplicate_prediction_count
selection_lists_semantics.empty_prediction: EMPTY prediction is a VALID zero-size scope, not missing data
selection_lists_semantics.added_file_rule: paths absent at the parent commit are counted as invalid_prediction_path_count and excluded from the OPWS patch with per-task/arm reason
selection_lists_semantics.no_post_hoc_editing: no path is added based on gold/reference-patch knowledge
